372: std::unique_ptr<PrePrefetchHandle>
373: PrePrefetchServiceImpl::StartPrePrefetchRequest(
374:     const GURL& url,
375:     const std::string& histogram_suffix,
376:     bool javascript_enabled,
377:     std::optional<net::HttpNoVarySearchData> no_vary_search_hint,
378:     std::optional<PrefetchPriority> priority,
379:     const net::HttpRequestHeaders& additional_headers,
380:     std::unique_ptr<PrefetchRequestStatusListener> request_status_listener,
381:     base::TimeDelta ttl,
382:     bool should_append_variations_header,
383:     bool should_disable_block_until_head_timeout,
384:     bool should_bypass_http_cache) {
385:   CHECK(!BrowserThread::CurrentlyOn(content::BrowserThread::UI),
386:         base::NotFatalUntil::M159);
387:   TRACE_EVENT("loading", "PrePrefetchServiceImpl::StartPrePrefetchRequest",
388:               "url", url);
389: 
390:   std::unique_ptr<const PrefetchRequest> prefetch_request =
391:       PrefetchRequest::CreateBrowserInitiatedWithoutWebContentsOffTheMainThread(
392:           browser_context_weak_on_ui_thread_, url,
393:           PrefetchType(PreloadingTriggerType::kEmbedder,
394:                        /*use_prefetch_proxy=*/false),
395:           histogram_suffix, blink::mojom::Referrer(), javascript_enabled,
396:           /*referring_origin=*/std::nullopt, std::move(no_vary_search_hint),
397:           priority,
398:           /*attempt=*/nullptr, additional_headers,
399:           std::move(request_status_listener), ttl,
400:           should_append_variations_header,
401:           should_disable_block_until_head_timeout, should_bypass_http_cache);
402: 
403:   return StartPrePrefetchRequestInternal(std::move(prefetch_request));
404: }
